subject: Where does our payment data physically live
body: Compliance review landed on my desk and I need to answer a question I cannot find covered anywhere in your reference docs. When we push a payment through, where does that data physically sit, and does it stay within a particular jurisdiction or can it move around? Our legal team specifically wants to know whether cardholder details ever leave the country we operate in. I have been through the payments pages and the error listings and I cannot see this addressed at all. Is there a page I am missing, or is this something I need to get in writing from somebody?
